title: Specified scalar projection comparison data on whole coefficient systems
statement: Let $J$ be a Grothendieck topology on an essentially small category and let $\varphi:R\to S$ be a map of commutative ring sheaves [def-coef-semilinear-system-models]. The restricted unit is $\operatorname{Res}_{\varphi}S$, the existing module-sheaf unit with its $R$ action restricted by $\varphi$. TensorWithUnit tensors a derived $R$-module with this module in degree zero. TensorNormalization records the ordinary pure-section comparison, its degreewise total-complex map, coefficient K-flatness and the derived comparison on K-flat representatives. For the finite-free strict coefficient towers and assertion $s$ of [lem-coef-finite-free-system-restriction], the remaining data are the specified geometric mates, tensor projection words, compact-support scalar comparison, refinement gamma and inverse-on-domain theta, finite-level adjunction/evaluation words, and fixed reduced-basis coordinate equations. These are definitions of the data and equations only, with no existence assertion.
